verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce documents a REST call to create a purchase intent (POST /acp/v1/instructions) with mandate fields like decline threshold and consumer prompt, functioning as an order-draft equivalent, and explicitly supports agent-initiated cancellation of that intent — both via documented protocol calls (supp-3). However, this is a payment-mandate object rather than a full cart (no line-item/quantity update semantics), and 'update' evidence is limited to cancellation rather than richer modification. Missing for 10: evidence of true cart/line-item update operations (not just cancel), and independent/hands-on confirmation the endpoint behaves as documented.
